title: Korean slang: 'I want to FREEZE-DRY my mom' 😳 #learnkorean
caption:
엄마 동결건조하고 싶다 (eom-ma dong-gyeol-geon-jo-ha-go sip-da)
Literally: "I want to freeze-dry my mom" 😳
Real meaning: "I wish Mom could stay just as she is, forever" 💗

Freeze-dried food keeps its shape for years — so in Korean internet slang, "freeze-dry" someone = keep them exactly as they are now. Mongle took it literally 😂

Words in this video:
동결건조 (dong-gyeol-geon-jo) = freeze-dried
동결… 건조? (dong-gyeol… geon-jo?) = freeze… dry?!
엄마를… 말린다고?! (eom-ma-reul… mal-lin-da-go?!) = you'd DRY your mom?!
간식 챙겨 가~ (gan-sik chaeng-gyeo ga~) = take your snacks~
봐, 동결건조 딸기. 그대로지? (bwa, dong-gyeol-geon-jo ttal-gi. geu-dae-ro-ji?) = see? freeze-dried strawberries — same shape!
잠깐… (jam-kkan…) = wait…
엄마, 늙지 마… (eom-ma, neuk-ji ma…) = Mom, don't get old…
얘는 참… (yae-neun cham…) = oh, you…
이렇게? (i-reo-ke?) = like this?
엄마~! (eom-ma~!) = Mom~!
엄마, 동결건조하고 싶어! (eom-ma, dong-gyeol-geon-jo-ha-go si-peo!) = Mom, I want to freeze-dry you!

Tip: it's recent social-media slang, not a dictionary word — Koreans use it with a smile about someone they love.

alt: A needle-felt miniature train station platform in warm afternoon light. A felt Korean daughter hugs her mom, who is about to leave by train, and murmurs 엄마 동결건조하고 싶다 (literally: I want to freeze-dry my mom). Mongle, a coral felt blob mascot, freezes in shock and repeats 동결… 건조? (freeze… dry?!). In Mongle's icy-blue daydream, the mom cheerfully steps into a cute felt freeze-dryer labelled 동결건조기, frost bursts out, and a little glass jar labelled 엄마 (MOM) slides out with a tiny smiling mom waving inside. Back on the platform Mongle trembles: 엄마를… 말린다고?! (you'd DRY your mom?!). The mom hands over a pouch of freeze-dried strawberries; the daughter shows Mongle one: 봐, 동결건조 딸기. 그대로지? (see? freeze-dried, same shape!). Mongle realises: 잠깐… (wait…). Holding her mom's hands, the daughter says 엄마, 늙지 마… (Mom, don't get old…), and a sign explains the real meaning: Mom, stay just as you are. The mom tears up and hugs her: 얘는 참… (oh, you…). From the train window the mom jokingly freezes in a flower pose: 이렇게? (like this?), and the train leaves. Alone on a bench, Mongle video-calls its own mom: 엄마~! then 엄마, 동결건조하고 싶어! (Mom, I want to freeze-dry you!). Mongle's mom freezes in horror as frost spreads over the screen and she imagines herself in a jar. End sign: 누구를 동결건조하고 싶어? Who would YOU freeze-dry?
_비고: video.mp4 = e58 최종본(음량마감). 표지 cover.png = 10.2초(💭 상상 칸 — 유리병 속 작은 엄마, 핵심 장면). 어린이 전용 아님. 합성 표시: 켜지 않음 — 펠트 미니어처 그림은 GPT 이미지로 구운 꾸민 장면이고 실제 사람 · 사건을 흉내 내지 않으며, 목소리는 특정인이 아닌 TTS. 10MB 올림판은 만들지 않았다 — 유튜브 스튜디오는 원본을 그대로 올린다.
